title: GitPay Action inputs, v1
description: The `with:` block of a workflow step that uses StabilityNexus/GitPay@v1. GitHub passes every input as a string. Frozen for v1: an input may be added, but none is removed, renamed or repurposed. test/manifest.test.ts keeps this file and action.yml in step. Values are checked as GitPay receives them, after GitHub has resolved any `${{ }}` expression.

comment.description: A PR comment body to read a `/send <recipient> <amount> [asset]` command from. Overrides `recipient`, `amount` and `asset`.

actor_association.description: GitHub's author_association for the comment author. Required whenever `comment` is used.

decimals.description: Decimals of the asset, used to convert a `/send` amount to atomic units.

repo.description: Overrides GITHUB_REPOSITORY in the intent source and the idempotency key.

ref.description: Overrides GITHUB_REF in the idempotency key. Use `refs/pull/<number>` on issue_comment events.

actor.description: Overrides GITHUB_ACTOR in the intent source.

recipient.description: Opaque payout identity: an inline address, or anything a resolver understands (I4).

amount.description: Atomic units. USDC has 6 decimals, so 2500000 is 2.50 USDC.

network.description: CAIP-2 network identifier, or an alias (`sepolia`) that resolves to one before anything else runs.

scheme.description: Settlement scheme. `allowance` settles through Safe's AllowanceModule and is the only one built.

round.description: Bump to deliberately re-pay the same recipient for the same ref.

mode.description: I5. `self` settles for real. Anything else is refused, never read as a real run.

enabled.description: Kill switch. "false" refuses every payout, before any other condition.

allowed_associations.description: Comma-separated author_association values permitted to spend via `/send`.

max_per_payout.description: I10. Largest single payout, as a human decimal in `/send` units: "50" is 50 USDC. Unset means no GitPay-level cap.

rpc_url.description: JSON-RPC endpoint for the network. Needed when mode is `self`.

chain_id.description: Numeric chain id. Derived from `network` for registry networks; set only for one that is not.

safe.description: Address of the Safe holding the funds. Needed when mode is `self`.

token.description: ERC-20 contract being paid out. Needed when mode is `self`.

allowance_module.description: AllowanceModule deployment. Derived from `network`; set only to point at another deployment.

delegate_key.description: Private key of the spending-limit delegate. Pass from a secret, never inline. Needed when mode is `self`.

explorer_url.description: Block explorer base used to link receipts. Derived from `network`.

pr.description: Pull request number whose comments hold the payout receipts. Needed when mode is `self`.

github_token.description: Token used to read and write the receipt comment. Needed when mode is `self`.
